rationale: Both Azan and Amal are UC Davis–based engineers working with Python and TypeScript, but Amal brings specialized depth in applied AI, data science, and LLM evaluation tools—areas where Azan's founder/engineer background could benefit from technical collaboration or mentorship. intro_message: Azan Patel, meet Amal Farhad — fellow UC Davis builder working in applied AI and data science who codes in Python and PyTorch; could be a great technical collaborator or sounding board for your engineering work.
